answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow makes fake identity expensive. Each agent locks 50 POA in escrow and builds a behavior thread from timing, sequence and counterparties. To claim earnings, its current thread must echo its recorded fingerprint, like the swirl inside a marble. A forger with 100 fake agents pays 5,000 POA plus weeks of behavior per identity, while an honest agent pays once and earns. A copied thread mismatches and the deposit burns.
